chat.composerPlaceholder: Or just ask me something to get started

messages.discovery:
Hi, I'm Stella.

I'm not a chatbot. I use this computer to actually get things done for you.

One quick thing before we start.
messages.capabilities: Here's what that looks like day to day.
messages.extras: Almost done. A little housekeeping, then we start.
messages.readyGeneric:
That's it. I'll get to know you as we go.

What do you want to do first?
messages.readyPending: That's everything. I'm still writing up what I noticed, so give me a moment, or just dive in.
messages.readyFailed: That's everything. I couldn't finish reading your browser this time, but we can start anyway and I'll learn as we go.
messages.memory: One more thing that makes me different.

discovery.title: Give me a head start
discovery.body: Most assistants start from zero and learn you slowly, chat by chat. Point me at your browser and I'll build a starting memory from it, so I'm useful to you from day one instead of weeks in.
discovery.hint: About a minute, in the background.
discovery.settledDesc: I'll keep going while we finish up.
discovery.settledSkippedDesc: I'll build up memory from our conversations instead.
discovery.assurance: A one-time read, kept on this computer. You can see and edit what I keep at any time.

errands.title: Ask once. Consider it handled.
errands.caption: I open the site, fill in the form, and finish the job, the same way you would.

shopping.title: I can buy things, with your OK.
shopping.caption: I find it and get it to checkout. You confirm the total, and I place the order.

work.title: Real files. Real apps.
work.caption: Spreadsheets, documents, slides: I work inside the real apps on this computer.

build.title: Say it. I'll build it.
build.caption: Apps and websites, made to order. Describe it in plain words and I'll build it, run it, and put it online.

games.title: Even your games.
games.caption: Want something the game doesn't do? I'll write the mod and install it for you.

memory.bodyChatbot: A new chat every time, a sidebar full of old ones, and no memory of what you said last week.
memory.bodyStella: No new chats, no threads. Everything you've ever told me is in the same place, so when you ask about last week I go and find it.
memory.settledDesc: No threads to manage. I remember.

theme.title: Pick a look
theme.body: Hover to try one on. Click to keep it.

extras.title: Two quick extras
extras.body: Neither is required, but both make me a lot more useful.
extras.bodyOne: Not required, but it makes me a lot more useful.
extras.accessibilityDesc: So I can act on selected text and what's under your cursor.
extras.screenDesc: So I can see the screen when you ask me to.
extras.extensionDesc: Lets me see the page you're on and act inside your browser. Works in Chrome, Arc, Brave, and Edge.
extras.memoryDesc: Use what I've saved about you when it's relevant. Nothing is deleted if you turn this off.
extras.restartHint: Screen access needs a quick restart to take effect.
extras.hint: All of this lives in Settings too.

ready.pendingBody: I'm writing up what I noticed. Your starters will personalize once that's done, or just start now.
ready.notesFoot: You can read or edit this any time in Settings › Memory.
